_doc: Games outside the Meta Store that can take the haptic layer (OpenXR loader in the APK, controller vibration). source.github = the tablet downloads the newest release APK by itself; source.page = only a web page (itch.io…): the browser opens, the APK lands in Downloads and is picked up from there by `file`. The patcher still refuses an APK without the OpenXR loader.
